data.title: 妮姆芙 · 全息数据流中透明光翼的电子咏唱
data.description: 在幽蓝的虚拟电子数据空间中，妮姆芙身为电子战用万能天使Type β，展开半透明七彩机械光翼 Paradise Song，无数全息屏在指尖跳跃。
data.location: 全息数字网络虚空核心
data.action: 悬浮于数据空间中央，纤细双手在多层环形全息屏幕上飞速操作，七彩透明光翼璀璨闪耀
data.lighting: 全息数据流散发的幽蓝与浅绿荧光，光翼折射出绚丽彩虹虹彩
data.camera: 动态俯瞰中景，科技感与科幻空灵感拉满
data.promptProse: Nymph hovers weightlessly inside the ethereal neon-blue void of a virtual cyberspace core, operating complex electronic warfare systems. Her delicate white Angeloid collar and armor pieces shine against glowing data streams, while her crystalline Paradise Song wings cast an iridescent rainbow luster across circular holographic monitors. Her small hands move with superhuman speed across glowing green glyphs with intense focus.
data.animaCaption: Floating in the luminous cyber domain, Nymph manipulates ringed holographic screens as her rainbow wings shimmer brilliantly.
